newsitem.title: POLAND: Celuloza falls seven pct after debut.
newsitem.headline: Celuloza falls seven pct after debut.

text.p: Poland's largest paper firm, Celuloza Swiecie SA, fell seven percent in active trade to 20 zlotys as investors took profits after the firm's 21.5-zloty bourse debut on Friday, traders said.
They said Friday's debut, 4.9 percent above Celuloza's public offering strike price of 20.5 zlotys, had been limited by the recent news the firm made a five-million-zloty first-quarter net profit.
The firm has forecast a 73-million-zloty net for all of this year and earned the same amount last year.
Analysts were divided on whether the stock would fall more or stay above 20 zlotys in the near term.
